fusions.name: Plague Pellets
fusions.desc: Fires 5 small pellets in a wide spread, each dealing 2 damage.

fusions.name: Stripping Cloud
fusions.desc: Fires a round that bursts into a devouring cloud, dealing 28 damage to the target and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Darkened Sky
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
